scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

apps.access_detail: Test access is distinct from production; developer token and access-level review generally apply.
apps.surface: REST + gRPC; campaigns, reporting and account resources
apps.note: OAuth is necessary but insufficient; verify developer-token access level and current Cloud-managed pilot rules.
apps.workflow: Run a Google Ads sandbox report
apps.next_action: Apply for the appropriate developer-token access and authorize a test Ads account before running a small reporting query.
apps.success_criterion: Return a test report and record developer-token level, OAuth scope and customer context.
apps.alternative_action: Begin token approval immediately; a captured Ads UI request does not replace developer-token authorization.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Own-account testing is distinct from managing other customers' accounts; permissions require review.
apps.surface: Graph HTTP API; campaigns, audiences, creatives and insights
apps.note: Meta Graph API is not GraphQL; recent access-tier naming changes warrant checking the exact product permission.
apps.workflow: Read an approved Meta ad account
apps.next_action: Confirm the exact Marketing API permissions and access tier, then read campaign metadata in an approved test account.
apps.success_criterion: Return the seeded campaign and record app permissions, account role and current access tier.
apps.alternative_action: Keep this Graph HTTP workflow separate from Threads; request missing permissions through the official review route.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Advertising API access requires approval; consumer sign-in access does not include Marketing APIs.
apps.surface: REST; ad accounts, campaigns, creatives and reporting
apps.note: Start outreach and access application before promising a production toolkit.
apps.next_action: Prepare a LinkedIn Marketing API access request for a specific read-only campaign-reporting workflow and ask about test accounts.
apps.success_criterion: Receive a documented access decision and the scopes needed for campaign reporting.
apps.alternative_action: If approval is pending, use an authorized report export as a limited data-ingestion prototype, not an API substitute.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Private Integration Tokens have a documented sandbox path; paid production capabilities need plan verification.
apps.surface: REST; contacts, calendars, opportunities and marketing
apps.note: Use OAuth for customer distribution; PITs suit controlled private integrations.
apps.workflow: Read a contact in a developer account
apps.next_action: Use a GoHighLevel development account and a controlled private integration token to read a seeded contact.
apps.success_criterion: Return the contact and location context; document OAuth requirements for customer distribution.
apps.alternative_action: Compare the marketplace OAuth path before expanding a private integration to multiple customer locations.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Key creation and OAuth paths are self-managed; free-plan eligibility for each target feature needs confirmation.
apps.surface: REST; audiences, campaigns, automations and reporting
apps.note: The marketing API is REST; unrelated GraphQL mentions on the landing page are not its protocol.
apps.next_action: Verify Mailchimp Marketing API access on the intended free or trial plan, then read a seeded audience member using a scoped account credential.
apps.success_criterion: Record plan entitlement and return the test member without sending a campaign.
apps.alternative_action: If a campaign workflow is missing from the public API, capture that authorized UI read and compare the response schema before proposing a wrapper.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Private scoped keys from account settings; public client keys have limited scope; plan quotas need confirmation.
apps.surface: REST; profiles, events, lists, campaigns and flows
apps.note: Do not confuse public tracking keys with privileged server-side API credentials.
apps.next_action: Confirm Klaviyo server-side API eligibility, create a least-privilege private key, and retrieve a seeded profile.
apps.success_criterion: Return the test profile using a private server key; demonstrate that a public tracking key cannot authorize it.
apps.alternative_action: Check whether official MCP exposes the same profile fields; otherwise use the documented profiles API.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Public API key generated in account settings; pricing entitlement not settled by the setup article.
apps.surface: Public HTTP API; contact and sales-workflow integrations
apps.note: Public API means documented interface, not unauthenticated access.
apps.next_action: Confirm systeme.io account/API eligibility and authenticate a read of a test contact tied to a known funnel.
apps.success_criterion: Return the seeded contact and record the supported contact or sales objects.
apps.alternative_action: Inspect a specific authorized funnel UI read only when the documented public API lacks a required relationship.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: App approval grants Trial access; broader Standard access requires further review.
apps.surface: REST; pins, boards and advertising resources
apps.note: A tier named Trial is still approval-gated; it is not necessarily instant self-serve access.
apps.workflow: List a test board after access approval
apps.next_action: Apply for Pinterest's developer access tier, confirm Trial-tier approval requirements, then list a test board.
apps.success_criterion: Document approval status and return the approved board with the granted permissions.
apps.alternative_action: Use a user-provided board export for exploratory analysis while approval is pending; do not label it an API integration.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Meta app with Threads use case and authorized user; broader distribution permissions need review.
apps.surface: HTTP Graph API; publish, retrieve and manage Threads content
apps.note: Threads tokens and permissions differ from Meta Ads; avoid reusing an unrelated Meta token.
apps.next_action: Confirm Threads-specific developer setup and token scopes, then read the authorized test profile or its posts.
apps.success_criterion: Return the intended profile and document token expiry and permissions without publishing content.
apps.alternative_action: Keep Threads OAuth and Meta Ads credentials separate; investigate browser requests only for authorized read fields missing from the supported API.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Create the first key in SendGrid UI; sender verification and current trial availability need confirmation.
apps.surface: REST; mail send, templates, contacts and statistics
apps.note: API authorization and permission to send as a domain are different setup steps.
apps.next_action: Confirm SendGrid account eligibility and create a restricted key for reading a test template, without enabling mail sends.
apps.success_criterion: Return template metadata and distinguish API scopes from domain-sending verification.
apps.alternative_action: If sending is later required, add verified-sender setup and separate send authorization as a new test.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
